lead_fa: Beast Mastery تنها اسپک ranged بازی است که ۱۰۰٪ آسیبش را در حال حرکت می‌زند؛ بیشتر آسیب تو از پت‌هات می‌آید و با [[Bestial Wrath]] و Barbed Shot چرخه می‌سازی. دو مسیر Hero Tree داری: [[Pack Leader]] که در همهٔ حالت‌ها قوی‌ترین است و [[Dark Ranger]] با [[Black Arrow]] و دفاع Smoke Screen.

strengths: Unlimited mobility: all of your damage is dealt while moving
Solid dungeon utility: Primal Rage, Tranquilizing Shot
Great at soloing old and new content
Aspect of the Turtle immunity plus solid emergency defensives
weaknesses: Pet AI is imperfect: pets get stuck in raids/dungeons, forcing dismiss/summon
Limited DPS on multiple targets that are not stacked
Utility tools can be awkward to use

changes_12_1.note: No fundamental changes in 12.1, only rebalances.

hero.recommendation: Pack Leader is the strongest hero tree in all situations at the moment.
hero.pack_leader: Summons three beast types via Howl of the Pack Leader: the Bear strikes and applies a large Bleed, the Boar charges through enemies, the Wyvern buffs your and your pet's damage. Other talents strengthen these effects; the core rotation stays mostly the same.
hero.dark_ranger: Black Arrow deals lots of upfront damage while spreading DoTs; dynamic gameplay based on enemy state and proc randomness; strong defensive option in Smoke Screen.

builds.codes_source: Wowhead 'Best Beast Mastery Hunter Talent Builds' page (wowhead.com/guide/classes/hunter/beast-mastery/talent-builds-pve-dps), export strings captured verbatim via the page's Copy buttons on 2026-10-27; do not modify.

concepts: The Pack Leader rotation plays around Nature's Ally and the tier set but is otherwise very straightforward.
Bestial Wrath on cooldown as often as possible: losing one use loses a lot of damage.
Keep Barbed Shot stacking for pet Frenzy and cooldown reduction on Bestial Wrath.

st_pack_leader: Barbed Shot if Bestial Wrath is available in the next 3 seconds or you are about to reach 2 charges
Kill Command with a Howl of the Pack Leader buff or Nature's Ally active
Cobra Shot with Cobra Fang active
aoe: Barbed Shot on your priority target if about to reach 2 charges
Bestial Wrath as long as Beast Cleave is active
Kill Command with a Howl of the Pack Leader buff or Nature's Ally active
Cobra Shot with Cobra Fang active
Barbed Shot on your priority target
opener: Before pull, apply Hunter's Mark to your target
As the pull starts, cast Barbed Shot twice
Use your potion, racials and trinkets if they boost your stats
Bestial Wrath (make sure your pet is attacking the target!)
rotation.bestial_wrath_notes: One cooldown: Bestial Wrath (short CD, highly impactful, many effects tied to it; both hero trees change it differently). Bloodshed applies to the target the pet is currently attacking: no pet attack means no bleed.

gear.gearing_rules: Agility > Mastery > Crit > Haste > Versatility (cheat sheet). Sim with Raidbots; the 4-set causes a minor rotational difference (slightly prioritize Cobra Shot while the 4-set damage increase is active).
gear.trinket_note: Font of Venomous Rage is situational.

tier_set.name: Skulking Viper's Ambush
tier_set.pc2: Barbed Shot causes your pets to stomp one additional time at 50% effectiveness.
tier_set.pc4: Stomp causes your next Cobra Shot to either benefit from Beast Cleave at 30% effectiveness or strike your primary target for 20% additional damage, stacking up to 4 times.

catalyst: Cuisses of the Uncoiled Union (The Coiled Altar)

notes: Sim your character for exact splits; the 4-set slightly raises Cobra Shot's priority while active.

consumables.combat_potion: Light's Potential (Raid) / Potion of Recklessness (near-BiS gear with low Versatility) / Liquid Luster (Mythic+)
consumables.weapon: Enchant Weapon - Rite of the Hash'ey

others: Flawless Masterful Peridot (one of each) + more Deadly/Quick Amethyst

enchants.head: Enchant Helm - Empowered Rune of Avoidance
enchants.chest: Enchant Chest - Mark of the Worldsoul
rings: Enchant Ring - Eyes of the Eagle

mplus.hero_note: Pack Leader carries the Best tags in Mythic+; Wild Thrash and Beast Cleave do the heavy lifting in packs.
tips: Misdirection on the tank every pull to protect your threat from pet opening bursts.
Liquid Luster is the go-to combat potion in M+.
Tranquilizing Shot covers enrage dispels; Primal Rage covers lust-less keys.
